148645.overview: A compilation tape of two games - Bomber and Jackpot.

148660.overview: Green Cross Frog is a single screen game where you have to get a frog across the screen from left to right while avoiding the traffic that moves up or down. You can move your frog in four directions and if you touch any of the vehicles then you lose one of five lives. There is an option to play a fast or slow game.
